The aluminum film is bonded to a ceramic substrate.
Use a substrate coefficient of thermal expansion of 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use an aluminum film coefficient of thermal expansion of 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use a temperature change of 180 K for cooling.
Calculate the thermal-mismatch strain in the film as ε = (α_film − α_substrate) × ΔT.
The resulting strain magnitude is 0.0027, or 0.27%.
The sign depends on the chosen convention, so state whether the film strain is tensile or compressive according to that convention.
